scene_purpose: Show the scale of destruction: millions of trees combed flat in a radial pattern.
main_subject: A vast flattened forest from an elevated viewpoint — trunks aligned radially away from a distant centre, bog pools scattered across the plain.

camera.angle: Elevated wide shot (low aerial, ~80-120 m), looking toward the epicentre direction
camera.composition: Foreground trunks fan from the bottom edge and converge toward a vanishing region near the horizon centre — the radial pattern IS the composition; pools break up the midground; horizon high in frame to emphasise ground.

lighting.direction: Flat overcast sky, weak brightness toward the horizon
lighting.intensity_and_character: Deliberately drained: no warm accent for the first time in the film; soft shadowless light, detail carried by texture not contrast.

foreground_elements: large fallen trunks with bark detail, broken branch stubs, root plates
background_elements: hazy plain continuing to the horizon
materials: wet bog water (matte reflection of sky)
environmental_details: radial alignment readable at every distance
a few 'telegraph pole' stripped trees still standing near centre (historically accurate)
animation_opportunities: slow aerial drift along the radial direction (matches s6_pattern.js)
can_simplify: distant trunks to instanced cylinders with baked vertex colour
pools to dark flat discs with low roughness

engine_mapping.world: world({ scorch: 0.4, snow: 0, skyEl: 25 overcast feel via turbidity 10 + envIntensity 0.6, fogColor: '#9aa0a4' })
engine_mapping.pattern: scenes/lib/world.js flatRadius(theta) butterfly zone + inFallZone/inStandZone: fallen = makeForest(update fall:1, dir away from EPI); centre: coniferGeometry({stripped:true}) standing — the exact s6_pattern.js data
engine_mapping.light: no DirectionalLight sun; HemisphereLight '#b8bcc0'/'#3a362e' + env only
engine_mapping.camera: slow high dolly, look-at pinned near EPI horizon
